sourceTitle: Nuts to crack; or Quips, quirks, anecdote and facete of Oxford and Cambridge Scholars
description: "Nuts to Crack; or Quips, Quirks, Anecdote and Facete of Oxford and Cambridge Scholars" is a comedic collection of anecdotes and witty observations likely written in the early 19th century. This work humorously recounts the life, customs, and rivalries of students and scholars from the prestigious universities of Oxford and Cambridge.
